title: 102: Box Box Club - Ranjith Ramanan & Kamal Kumar
description: On the podcast: Ranjith Ramanan and Kamal Kumar share how a Formula 1 widget concept posted on Twitter became Box Box Club, the F1 app that Mercedes tweeted about and Charles Leclerc was spotted using. They talk about how a fan's TikTok fueled the early growth, why users asking to pay led to a subscription, how day-one lock screen widgets turned one tweet into 250,000 downloads, what they learned from a legal notice from Formula 1, how going full-time led to GO Club, and the bigger vision for their company, Arkade Club.
